name: Owner's pick 8 Nov 2026
goal: TikTok for small shops: 3 types of short video a small shop can film with one phone.
rule: OWNER'S CHOSEN TOPIC for this article (owner, 7 Nov 2026): «TikTok សម្រាប់ហាងតូច៖ វីដេអូ ៣ ប្រភេទ ថតដោយទូរស័ព្ទមួយគ្រឿង». Teach three video types a small online shop can film with one phone: (1) packing a real order, (2) before/after or wearing/using the product, (3) answering a question customers often ask. Add: the first 3 seconds must catch attention, film in natural light, post regularly. It follows the 5 Nov article «លក់តាម Facebook ដាច់ហើយ តើហាងតូចគួរចាប់ផ្ដើម TikTok ឥឡូវនេះទេ?» (that one answered 'should I start?'; this one answers 'what do I film?'), so link to it once. Do not promise followers or sales. ADS BOX only in the closing call to action (Boost TikTok fits).
